# Vixen Cybernetics — source-bound AI research guide

Canonical Opera: /encyclopedia/vix-cyb.html
Human-readable AI entrance: /encyclopedia/vix-cyb/llms.txt
Machine-readable Podium routes: /encyclopedia/reference/podium/manifest.json
Machine dispatcher: /encyclopedia/reference/vixen-podium.mjs
Original research guide in Git: VIXEN_START_HERE.md

STATUS: RESEARCH PREVIEW. HUMAN PRODUCT REVIEW OUTSTANDING.
This guide describes the current research interface, not approval to publish, deploy, acquire sources, alter a corpus, or make claims of independent empirical replication. Inspect the currently served version and its associated source SHA before claiming a capability or outcome.

## The constitutional separation

OPERAHOUSE ≠ OPERA ≠ PERFORMER

- OPERAHOUSE: the hosting, reference transport, source-verification and bounded tool infrastructure. It cannot grant authorship to a Work or convert its own reference records into Vixen studies.
- OPERA: Vixen Cybernetics, its questions, interpretations, source-specific instruments, research pathways and human-directed interface.
- PERFORMER: each original Work and recorded manifestation, with stated authorship, original location, immutable identifier and outstanding identity questions.

The Opera comprises 32 canonical Works and 53 recorded linked manifestations; eight human identity gates remain unresolved. Twenty-one documentary methods are recorded. The original historical source, its derivative body and the machine's interpretation are separate evidence classes. Preserve every distinction.

An independently searchable 1,141-record reference index belongs to the OPERAHOUSE. It may be consulted through separately declared read-only research tools; its records do not automatically become Vixen Works, authors, demonstrations or admissible cross-study links. The cross-study warrant register currently contains zero admitted mappings.

## AI collaborator onboarding — begin here

1. Ask the human what question or original Work they wish to examine. Select one Work in Works, or two explicitly chosen Works in Salon. Never silently choose or merge authors.
2. Read the original source and its metadata separately. Report exact Work and manifestation IDs, readable text vs metadata-only cases, source availability, declared attribution and uncertainty. Do not invent missing PDF text.
3. Distinguish retrieval evidence (lexical/semantic/semiotic matching) from original recorded source; search scores are relevance signals, not scientific findings.
4. State a competing explanation and at least one falsifier for a proposed synthesis. If independent evidence is missing, label it missing. A proposal or model simulation has empirical credit zero.
5. Respect stage boundaries, current consent, rest/exit, and the separate Program Notes opt-in. A machine may prepare a proposal; only the human may grant consequential approval.
6. Provide a source-linked handoff or locally exported research session rather than claiming persistent remote storage.

Use the visible Podium research invitations for plain-language prompts. They are clipboard assistance, never execution authority.

## Two research modes

MAESTRO: evidence-led exploration, original-source reading, rabbit holes and multiple candidate next inquiries. This is a read-only investigative role. Preserve dissent and unresolved sources.

COMPOSER: develop provisional interpretations, counterfactuals, candidate questions and falsifiable research designs. Every output remains a proposal. A machine Score cannot authorize a publication, source mutation, visual replacement, release or deployment.

One active role is selected per session. Changing roles requires a new session. Program Notes require independent permission, separate from other collaboration consent; they cannot retroactively authorize earlier activity. The browser does not imply that a live external model is connected merely because it can display suggestions.

## Machine Podium — accurate route census

The current machine manifest declares 27 typed routes. Resolve the current manifest, rather than relying on stale route counts or copying the website's presentation labels into task IDs.

Core reading:
podium.describe; vixen.work.inspect; vixen.gates.inspect.

Independent reference transport, only after explicit selection:
universal.open; universal.search; universal.get; universal.related.

Provisional synthesis:
synthesis.propose; vixen.salon.compose; experiment_b.preregister.
The final route name is an internal compatibility ID for drafting a HELD future study, not permission to conduct one.

Native adapters:
engine.capabilities; engine.invoke.
Availability depends on an independently authorized host. Listed adapters, named specialists and machine methods are neither implicitly connected nor executed when named.

Semantic–semiotic research:
vixen.fusion.capabilities; vixen.fusion.search; vixen.fusion.compare; vixen.fusion.explain.
Search channels and ablation profiles must preserve their source-specific ceilings. Full-index experiments cannot silently substitute a fallback dataset.

Review and human composition:
podium.score; podium.redpen; podium.compose.
A generated Score can inform human editorial deliberation, but it does not carry the authenticated human approval required for consequential composition.

Session collaboration:
vixen.ai.start; vixen.ai.choose; vixen.ai.report; vixen.ai.status; vixen.ai.notes; vixen.ai.handoff; vixen.ai.archive; vixen.ai.finish.
All eight routes follow the declared session-state/role and consent contracts. Notes and archive creation require explicit human intent. A human report remains a human-supplied observation, not machine-verified fact.

Task envelope: schema td613.vixen.podium.task/v1 with an exact declared intent and a typed params object. Read the source-specific route inputs from the machine manifest. A task JSON object, browser button, copied prompt or supplied approval flag cannot grant privileged tool rights.

Example read-only task:
{"schema":"td613.vixen.podium.task/v1","intent":"podium.describe","params":{}}

Do not expose native host-attestation flags, provider credentials, internal engineering commands or backstage methods as a visitor-facing control. The public browser is a research experience, not a developer console.

## Where the evidence lives

- Works: 32 original records; selected manifestation with readable source and stated author. Maintain each source's literal filename and title.
- Folios: recorded manifestations of one selected original Work, with source identity and explicit metadata ceiling. No foreign reference masquerades as a Performer.
- Observatory: bounded instrument and original-Work mathematical wardrobe. Mathematical excerpts require canonical source binding, not a self-hashed caller string.
- Salon: two human-selected Works, comparison order, documentary method and provisional composition. An order-dependent result cannot assert shared authorship or causal influence.
- Search: separate lexical, semantic, semiotic and documentary-route contributions. Similarity never creates a cross-study warrant.
- Podium Settings & Ledger: local research history, current model diagnostics, research prompts and human review status. It has no credential, host-native execution or deployment path.
- Save Session: local portable ZIP with explicit missing-reference holds. The browser-generated session does not contain the complete independent reference corpus; its absence must be stated accurately.

Do not declare them integrated, cited, searched, or authenticated until new evidence and a new version demonstrate that.

The current research preview may be refined before that evaluation. Treat earlier preview SHA, final edit SHA, pre-acquisition SHA and any later hydrated SHA as separate immutable comparison points.

The original historical first Temporal epoch remains missing. Documentary method bodies are not automatically executable or independently experimentally replicated. Eight identity gates remain for people to adjudicate. External origin cannot be inferred solely from a byte-perfect admitted record.

## Boundaries on advice and output

Give source coordinates, method, observed output, missing substrate, competing reading, and next operator-controlled step. Never convert a held result into a successful measurement. No automatic release, main merge, provider synchronization, new Work admission, protected trial, or scientific closure. Stay within the human's current instruction and the actual read-only tool environment.
